name: HR Onboarding Assistant — RAG over the handbook

nodes.name: New hire asks a question
nodes.notes: PRODUCTION: Slack Events API / slash command posts the new hire's question here.

parameters.jsCode:
// Demo question from a new hire.
return [{ json:{ query:"How many PTO days do I get and how do I request them?", user:"@new.hire", channel:"#ask-hr" }}];

nodes.name: Read the question
nodes.notes: Extracts the query + who asked + which channel to reply in.

nodes.name: Search the employee handbook
nodes.notes: PRODUCTION: embed query (Voyage/OpenAI) → pgvector similarity search over the chunked employee handbook. Returns top-K chunks + scores.

nodes.name: Did we find a good answer?
nodes.notes: Grounding gate: only answer when retrieval is confident. Otherwise hand to a human — the bot never guesses.

nodes.name: Write the answer
nodes.notes: PRODUCTION: Claude answers constrained to the retrieved chunks only — refuses if unsupported. Citations attached.

nodes.name: Reply in Slack
nodes.notes: PRODUCTION: Slack chat.postMessage back in-thread with the answer + handbook citations.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json:{ action:"escalated", to:"#people-team", reason:"no handbook chunk above confidence threshold", status:"handed to human" }}];

nodes.name: Ask a human instead
nodes.notes: PRODUCTION: low-confidence → route to a human + log the gap so the handbook gets improved.

main.node: Did we find a good answer?
